title: Virgo, you were never the rough draft
caption: for the virgos editing themselves at midnight

scenes.text: you notice everything. the typo, the tone, the pause before fine.
mercury built you a mind that edits the world while it walks.
so you love the way you do everything: carefully, and in lists.
you'd fix their week, their sink, their cover letter, quietly.
and then you go home and edit yourself harder than anyone.
every flaw you catch in them, you caught in yourself first.
you're an earth sign. soil is never tidy, and it still grows things.
so stop drafting a cleaner version of you to send out.
put your dealbreakers up front, then let the rest be human.
say the honest thing early. the right one will read it as care.
you are not a draft, virgo. no one is waiting on a final copy.
put the red pen down tonight. nothing here needs fixing.
